messages:

Cc:

Subject: Draft product page copy + AMI / SKU info — need quick review

Hi team,

Attached is the working set of assets for the AWS Marketplace product page we need to submit this week: hero blurb, feature bullets, three screenshots, and the AMI manifest (ami-manifest-20260823.json). Tim at Acme asked for an anticipated launch window and the exact Seller ID mapping so their procurement can finish the PO.

Asks:
- Marissa: please review the hero paragraph and the 5 feature bullets for clarity and co-sell callouts. Keep edits inline.
- Karthik: can you confirm the AMI manifest fields (region/instance types) and whether the technical claim about "99.9% inference availability" needs softening?
- I will collect the screenshots and SKU mapping and send to AWS once we have final copy.

Deadline: can we get a 24-hour turnaround? AWS has a small window next week to push the change.

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_hero_2026_v1.pdf (pdf), ami-manifest-20260823.json (json), sku-mapping-sheet.csv (csv)

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft product page copy + AMI / SKU info — need quick review

On Mon, Aug 23, 2026 at 09:12, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Attached is the working set of assets for the AWS Marketplace product page we need to submit this week...

Thanks Diego — looked through the hero and bullets. High-level edits below and I left tracked comments in the PDF for tone and length. Main suggestions:
- Hero: tighten first sentence to lead with customer problem ("Reduce inference cost and latency for LLMs in production"); remove technical jargon in one-liner.
- Bullets: reorder so cost/latency/ops are first three; add a brief callout for "Dedicated and Private deployment options" for enterprise search.
- CTA: change "Start generating" -> "Request a live demo or AMI access" (helps co-sell and measurement).

I also added alt text recommendations for the screenshots (keeps the listing accessible and meets AWS guidelines).

Small nit: we probably shouldn't call out a numeric SLA in the public description without legal sign-off — flagging for Karthik and legal.

Marissa
Product Marketing Manager

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-23T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft product page copy + AMI / SKU info — need quick review

Diego / Marissa,

Confirmed: the AMI manifest is structurally fine for the US regions we plan to publish (us-east-1, us-west-2). I've added one required field to the manifest (kernel version) — attached a one-line diff in the Drive link. Instance types: we should list m5.large, g4dn.xlarge as supported; avoid claiming exhaustive compatibility.

About the claim: "99.9% inference availability" — that's a product SLA, not a marketing claim. Recommend replacing public text with: "SLA-backed dedicated capacity available for enterprise customers". That preserves the capability message without publishing the SLA number. Legal will need to sign off, but marketing copy should make that change now.

I'll be OOO tomorrow morning but will check for final sign-off before you send to AWS.

Karthik
Senior Systems Engineer — Serving Runtime

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tim Jones <tim.jones@acme.com>

- redwood_marketplace_hero_2026_v1.pdf (final copy, hero + bullets + CTA)
- ami-manifest-20260823.json (AMI manifest, includes region list and kernel version)
- sku-mapping-sheet.csv (SKU -> pricing tier mapping)

- AMI family: redwood-inference-2026-ami (official release)
- Preferred go-live window: Sept 7–9, 2026 (flexible, but procurement at Acme has requested Sept 8 as preferred)

Tim (ACME) is looped in to confirm procurement timing.

Two asks for AWS team:
1) Can you confirm the Seller ID mapping and provide the internal listing ID once created?
2) Please send the DocuSign link for the Private Offer paperwork (Acme will sign).

Thanks — Diego

Hi Diego — thanks for the assets. Quick notes:
- Seller ID 1234567890 is confirmed and we've provisionally created listing draft ID: AWS-LST-998211.
- We validated the AMI manifest for us-east-1/us-west-2; please confirm that the AMI is public in those accounts or that you will provide a share to our marketplace scanning account.
- DocuSign: sending private offer link to Tim's email now (expect link within 2 hours).

One minor content item: the hero paragraph references "on-prem package for air-gapped environments" — that's allowed, but please add a one-line footnote that on-prem deployments are delivered via a separate package and may incur additional Ops fees. This helps set expectation for customers.

We can target the Sept 8 go-live if DocuSign completes this week. I'll follow up with the listing ID once the draft is published to production.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Enablement
